legend: The SS Baychimo, Arctic ghost ship (Alaska, 1931-1969)
lines: In October nineteen thirty-one, a cargo steamer named Baychimo was trapped in Arctic ice near Alaska.
Her crew left her behind, sure she would sink.
But after a blizzard, the ship was still there.
Empty, silent, and floating all alone.
For the next thirty-eight years, sailors and villagers spotted her drifting through the ice.
A few brave people climbed aboard, but nobody could tow her home.
She was last reported in nineteen sixty-nine.
Legend says she still sails the Arctic tonight, with no one at the wheel.
title: The Ghost Ship That Drifted the Arctic for 38 Years #shorts
description:
In 1931 the steamer Baychimo was abandoned in Arctic ice, yet she kept drifting for decades with no crew. Legend says she is still out there.
